international.title: ‘Crisis in empathy’: prison guard was watching TV while Aboriginal man was dying in custody, NSW coroner finds
international.summary: Judge says officers should be banned from screens and phones while on shift after the 33-year-old’s death at Silverwater • Warning: This article contains references to Indigenous Australians who have died The NSW coroner has found the death of an Aboriginal man in custody in 2023 was not only preventable but was “one of the most egregious deaths” she had investigated. Corrective Services NSW has been recommended to overhaul officer training for self-harm responses, and ban officers’ access to TV and YouTube while on shift. Continue reading...
